# `aube access get status`

- **Usage:** `aube access get status <PACKAGE>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Get a package's public or restricted status.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
